summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a definitive agreement to acquire GeoPura Limited for $275 million in upfront consideration, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. The acquisition, expected to close later in 2026, would establish Ballard as an energy-as-a-service provider and combine its fuel cell technology with GeoPura's hydrogen genset leasing model. Ballard's CEO highlighted strategic benefits including revenue visibility and recurring service revenue. Watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions; the deal is part of Ballard's path to profitability by end-2027.
